title: H264b: Crypto Momentum with Adaptive Trailing Stop
rationale: H264 NOT CONFIRMED (OOS Sharpe 0.662 vs gate 0.75) — the 2022 bear drew down -37% because the monthly signal exits too slowly. arXiv:2602.11708 (AdaptiveTrend, Sharpe 2.41, MaxDD -12.7%, 2022-2024) uses a trailing stop calibrated to intra-day volatility to exit losing crypto positions mid-month. The hypothesis: adding a weekly trailing stop check to H264's monthly momentum signal can materially reduce MaxDD while preserving the upside. This maps directly to the 'H264b watch-and-wait' lead noted after H264.

  TC:        20bp per side
  TRAIL_STOP_PCT: test 10%, 15%, 20% (grid search)

  MaxDD OOS > -45% (H264 was -46%)

  NegYrs OOS <= 2
